data.title: AI blurs lines in campaign ads: ‘People are seeing things that didn’t happen’ | CNN Politics
data.description: Political campaigns and groups are spending tens of millions of dollars on ads that employ AI, often without disclosing that they’re using it.
data.author: Casey Tolan, Fredreka Schouten, David Wright, Rhyannon Bartlett-Imadegawa, Sarah Hashemi
